changes.title: Argentina's Milei escalates Falklands dispute, seizing on Trump comments and oil tensions
changes.summary: Argentine President Javier Milei is escalating a dispute with Britain over the Falkland Islands with tougher sanctions targeting companies involved in a major offshore oil project (Image credit: Ricardo Mazalan).

changes.title: President Javier Milei says ‘winds of change’ support Argentina’s claim to Falkland Islands
changes.summary: President cites Donald Trump’s suggestion that he might reconsider US support for British sovereignty, and threatens swifter sanctions on British oil interests President Javier Milei has said “winds of change favourable” to Argentina’s claim to the Falkland Islands were “blowing around the world” in a televised address.
